page.overview:
Who is Anzu?

is a genus of oviraptorosaurian dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of North and South Dakota. Its fossils were found in the Hell Creek formation. Because of the creature's appearance, it is jokingly nicknamed the "chicken from hell". Anzu is known for being the first well-preserved example of an oviraptorosaur in North America.

Anzu's only appearance in the Jurassic Park franchise is being featured in the Jurassic World: Dinosaur Field Guide, replacing Chirostenotes from the Jurassic Park: Dinosaur Field Guide. This may be because the fossils attributed to Anzu were once referred to Chirostenotes.
